stable_propositions.text: The project is no longer principally a map of powerful people; it is a study of how knowledge becomes authority, authority becomes infrastructure, and counterpower can interrupt the conversion.
K0 precedes C1: epistemic admissibility determines which knowers and contradictions may enter problem definition and option formation.
Same mechanism is not communication; compatible interfaces are not common purpose; functional integration is not one legal organization.
Distributed counterpower aversion is a field hypothesis with controls and falsifiers, not a network finding or psychological diagnosis.
Question 4 is the experimental intervention against the field hypothesis: observed binding correction is counterevidence against the strongest negative constitution.
External participation is required for an external claim, not for internal reasoning; missing review alone cannot block bounded reversible judgment.
Canonical repository state records what has merged and passed the declared gates; it does not itself establish evidence truth, independence, adoption, or operational effect.
No real-person pilot is authorized before the external reproduction, separated adjudication, registry-support, affected-party-standing, custody, and no-adverse gates are satisfied.
The project closes only on observed cross-domain and cross-jurisdiction counterpower or an evidence-supported terminal finding that the architecture cannot transfer.

authority_tiers.name: field hypothesis

authority_tiers.name: publication projection

authority_tiers.may_support: reproduction, adjudication, adoption, gateholder obedience, remedy, and durability only when the required external receipts exist
